title: Dharavi redevelopment: how a land-funded rehab model pays for free 350 sq ft homes
text:
Free housing at scale needs a funding source; in Dharavi, that source is the land itself.
The May 2025 master plan covers 58,532 homes and 13,468 commercial and industrial units across about 2.39 sq km.
Eligible pre-2000 ground-floor families get 350 sq ft at no cost; about 9.5 crore sq ft of rehab must be delivered before about 13 crore sq ft of saleable space (Business Today, Jul 2026).
For developers and investors, the order matters: cash flow arrives only after the rehab obligation, so execution speed decides returns. Phase 1 targets 10,000 homes in about 18 months.
Where have you seen sale-component funding work, or stall, in Indian slum redevelopment?
